Century

Century uses two distinct d10 to create results from 1 to 100. Every participant stakes an amount and secretly chooses from two to ten distinct numbers in that range. Once all selections are locked, the Dealer generates twenty different results, rerolling a duplicate.

Resolution

The module compares every player’s chosen numbers with the twenty results, then displays matches, the applicable multiplier, and the payout. A player’s multiplier depends on both the count of numbers selected and the count matched, using the published Century payout matrix.

Examples

Numbers selectedNumbers matchedPayout multiplier
211×
225×
322×
55200×
10105000×

Refer to the source table for every available multiplier; the module applies the complete table automatically.

Loaded dice

A Dealer with an item slugged games-loaded-dice may choose the twenty distinct results. The selection must contain exactly twenty unique whole numbers from 1 through 100. Without that item, the module draws all results normally.

Source acknowledgement. Century originates in Pathfinder #159: All or Nothing, p. 76, as presented by Archives of Nethys.
